subject: Clarify SOC 2 Type II coverage months + bridge letter request

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@clearstream.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — quick question on months covered and bridge letter

Hi Neha,

Thanks for sending the SOC 2 Type II report link in the questionnaire. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we route this to our InfoSec and procurement teams:

- Does the report cover the full months from 2024-06-01 through 2024-11-30 inclusive (i.e., controls performed throughout those months), or is the auditor indicating a point-in-time snapshot with a cutoff on 2024-11-30 for some control families?
- If there is any gap between the report end date and the date Redwood can provide evidence, would Redwood be able to supply a bridge letter that affirms there were no material changes to controls from 2024-12-01 through the present? Our renewal timeline needs cover until at least 2025-01-15.

Also can you confirm who from Redwood signs bridge letters (title) and whether you can provide any specific control evidence (e.g., change management logs, access review artifacts) for the last week of November?

We're trying to finalize the security sign-off by next Friday. Appreciate a short confirmation so we can move forward.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Liu
Security Program Manager, Clearstream Health
